name: Integer AX Octa Joint bottom bracket
weight_description: Weight not yet sourced for the BB-AX31 Octa Joint assembly explicitly identified in the Shimano FC-AX21/BB-AX31 drawing. The 1982 catalogue instead labels its BB as BB-SL32; that model’s 325 g figure is not transferred without evidence that the assemblies are identical.
